Class PlayerSpaceship

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.Spaceship
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.PlayerSpaceship
public class PlayerSpaceship extends Spaceship
The player-controlled ship. Reads WASD from InputManager and moves with inertia (accelerates, keeps drifting, slows via friction — feels like ice rather than snapping to a fixed speed). After taking a hit it becomes briefly invulnerable and blinks on screen so the player gets clear "you got hit, you're safe for a moment" feedback.
